retrieval.name: OpenSearch Documentation
retrieval.description: OpenSearch vector/hybrid search and quantization. Resolve current version features at use-time.

retrieval.name: pgvector
retrieval.description: Postgres vector extension; combine with full-text/BM25 for in-database hybrid search. Verify current quantization (halfvec) support at use-time. Check dimension caps and iterative-scan support in the README.

books.name: AI-Powered Search — Trey Grainger, Doug Turnbull, Max Irwin (Manning, 2025)
books.description: Semantic knowledge graphs for query classification and query-sense disambiguation (ch. 6); signals-boosting models and the index-time vs query-time boosting tradeoff (ch. 8). Source for the query-classification and signals-boosting sections in SKILL.md.
